description: List the dynamic QR codes in the person's QRdx workspace, newest first: id, title, short link, destination, status and scan count. Use it to find a code's id for get_code_stats or update_code_destination, or to answer which codes they have. Needs the person signed in to QRdx.

q.description: Words to find in titles, short links and destinations

status.description: Active codes (default), archived ones or both

name: list_codes
title: List dynamic QR codes
